_comment: Atlas classifications, the EVX Data Products glossary and Ranger tag masking for the rsingh_evx_* databases, applied by scripts/governance.py. Only EVX_* classifications, the EVX glossary and rsingh-evx-* policies are created or changed; other projects' tags and policies are left alone. All data is synthetic.

EVX_SENSITIVE_PII.description: Identifies a person (rider name, vehicle registration, technician code): masked users see a hash, so counts and joins still work (DPDP personal data)

EVX_SENSITIVE_CONTACT.description: Rider contact details (phone, email, address, pincode): letters become x, digits n

EVX_SENSITIVE_LOCATION.description: Precise rider home location: masked users see NULL (analysts use geohash5, about 5 km)

masking._comment: rsingh is in no masking policy and sees clear values

glossary.name: EVX Data Products
glossary.description: Data products and certified KPIs of the EV Factory-to-Field Lakehouse (synthetic data). One term per domain, assigned to the domain's gold tables, and one per certified KPI (config/kpi.json), assigned to its semantic views.

domains.name: EVX Supply Batch
domains.description: Suppliers and supplier material batches from SAP, CoA PDFs and XRF spectra; batch quality status is SCD2 (received, released, suspect from a supplier 8D).

domains.name: EVX Cell Grade
domains.description: Cell MES steps, formation and grading measurements, X-ray and film inspections with image metrics.

domains.name: EVX Pack Genealogy
domains.description: Packs and vehicles (SCD2 on fitment, pack swaps and BMS firmware), pack and vehicle EOL tests, and the pack to cell to material-lot genealogy.

domains.name: EVX Field Event
domains.description: Vehicle daily telematics, DTCs (battery-related and safety-floor flags) and EDR events, which arrive up to 72 hours late by design.

domains.name: EVX Warranty Claim
domains.description: Riders (personal data, masked), service job cards (PDF and scanned) and warranty claims, with the VIN resolved through master.xref.
